---
name: Bug report
about: Report incorrect or missing init-rules behavior
labels: bug
---

### What happened?

Describe the incorrect behavior and its effect on the generated rules or report.

### How can it be reproduced?

Include the `/init-rules` command and a minimal repository example or relevant file layout. Include your Claude Code version if known.

### Expected and actual result

Explain what you expected and what happened instead. Share a short excerpt of the generated output if it helps.

### Checks performed

List any checks you ran and their results. Remove secrets and private repository content before posting.
